Founded in 1895, Aston University is a long-established research-led university recognised for its quality of world-class learning and powerful connections with sector, government and trade. The task of the university is to provide a sustainable campus that will enhance the student experience.  Currently, the University has a student population of over 14,000 registered from 135 nations worldwide.

Either as an optional module in your degree, you can choose to study French, German, Spanish, Mandarin or Arabic while you are at Aston. In 2010, Aston University ranked first for quality of life for students, while FHM and Virgin Student ranked it among the country's most friendly universities.

The university features state-of-the-art lecture halls, laboratories, and research centers, providing students with access to cutting-edge technology and resources.

The campus also includes sports facilities, such as a gymnasium and sports halls, and outdoor spaces. The campus also houses various dining options, cafes, and social spaces, encouraging a vibrant community atmosphere.

Business and career-minded students can access networking opportunities organised by Aston University regularly. Student life is vibrant in a city praised for its multicultural focus and embrace of all cultures. It has a 90% student satisfaction rate.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
Founded in 1895, Aston University is a long-established research-led university recognised for its world-class learning quality and powerful connections with sectors, government, and trade. The University provides a sustainable campus that will enhance your student experience.  Currently, the University has a student population of over 14,000 registered from 135 nations worldwide. Aston is also rated Triple Gold in the UK’s Teaching Excellence Framework.

Aston not only offers a wide range of postgraduate opportunities but also an impressive selection of undergraduate courses designed to support you in today’s global landscape. From 2025, all undergraduate students will benefit from Aston’s newly launched Power Skills. 

These include AI & Digital, Environmental Sustainability, Innovation & Entrepreneurship, and Inclusive Leadership. These core skills complement Aston’s strong emphasis on employability through hands-on learning, real-world challenges and professional placements.

Additionally, either as an optional module in your degree, you can choose to study French, German, Spanish, Mandarin or Arabic while you are at Aston. In 2010, Aston University ranked first for quality of life for students, while FHM and Virgin Student ranked it among the country's most friendly universities.

highlights.title: Student Life
highlights.value: Aston has a 90% student satisfaction rate. Life on campus provides you with opportunities to engage in university events, meet fellow students, and easily access its facilities. You can also access networking opportunities organised by Aston University on a regular basis.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
When you make Aston University your first choice or possess an unconditional offer to study full-time at the university, you are guaranteed accommodation. Aston University offers desirable well-equipped residences, including the William Murdoch Halls, Lakeside, and James Watt Halls, among others.

These accommodations offer a mix of ensuite rooms and shared flats, providing you with a comfortable living environment. Amenities typically include communal kitchens, shared bathrooms and study spaces. The on-campus housing options are located close to university facilities and lecture halls.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options, download our app and check out the Stays feature!
